card.name: Tour itinerary day-by-day wording
card.fires_on: Small words (for, a, we, and, After) and spaces inside a dated day-by-day travel tour itinerary, in lines about gathering, dinners and departures. All the examples come from one Albany history tour.

modes.label: Linking words in itinerary lines
modes.description: Small words such as for, a, we, and, after that follow a day heading or place name in a tour schedule.
modes.example: Sunday, September 29 Gather in Albany, New York<< for>> a briefing and welcome dinner hosted by Frank

modes.label: Right after the date
modes.description: The space or first word following a day-and-date heading that opens the day's plan.
modes.example: Saturday, October 5<< >>Depart at your leisure following breakfast.

card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in a daily travel-tour schedule, such as a dinner or departure line.
evidence: Return to Albany<< for>> our farewell dinner and final overnight.
Monday, September 30 <<After>> a brief stop at the Phillip Schuy
Saturday, October 5 Depart at your<< leisure>> following breakfast.
